14-1.title: Simple RAG pipeline
14-1.tldr: The most common starting point: embed the query, get top-k similar docs, stuff them into the prompt, and generate.

14-2.title: Modular RAG with reranking
14-2.tldr: The upgrade once simple RAG returns irrelevant context: retrieve a larger candidate set, rerank by relevance, and keep only the top results.

14-3.title: Agentic tool-calling pattern
14-3.tldr: The model decides when to call external functions: it emits a structured tool call, the tool executes, the result is fed back, and the loop continues.
points: Runtime executes and feeds back results.

14-4.title: Planner–executor pattern
14-4.tldr: A planner breaks a complex request into subtasks; one or more executors carry each out; results are combined into a final response.

14-5.title: Critic or reflection loop
14-5.tldr: A self-check before returning: the primary agent drafts, a critic reviews against the request or rules, and the primary revises if it fails.

14-6.title: Memory-augmented agent
14-6.tldr: Context across sessions: short-term is the active window; long-term is a store of past interactions; retrieval decides what long-term memory returns.

14-7.title: Router pattern
14-7.tldr: One entry point decides which subsystem handles the request: the query is classified and routed to a specialized agent or tool.
